DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩で行ってみたい場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided where you would like to go for your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この図の端まで行きたいです。でも帰りも歩くことをあまり考えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の端へ行きたいが帰りの歩行を考えていなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the edge of this map. But I had not really thought about having to walk back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to go to the edge of the map but had not considered the walk back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 往復の負担も含めて、無理のない目安を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us set a manageable guideline that takes the effort of the round trip into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行く途中で疲れたら、目的地まで進まず戻ってもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 疲れたら目的地前でも戻ってよいと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I get tired on the way, it is all right to turn back without reaching the destination, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you may turn back before reaching the destination if you get tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。通れる経路や休憩場所は現地の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please also check the signs on site for accessible routes and places to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図の休憩の印を見ました。そこが使えなかった場合は、先へ進むより戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩印の場所が使えなければ先へ行かず帰りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw the rest-area symbol on the map. If that place is unavailable, I would rather turn back than go farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that if the place marked for rest cannot be used, you would like to return instead of continuing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休める場所が必ず使えるとは限らない点も、考えておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is also good to bear in mind that a place to rest may not always be available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行する兄にも、今日は端まで行く約束ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必ず端まで行く計画ではないことを兄に伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my older brother, who is coming with me, that we are not promising to reach the edge today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your older brother that reaching the edge is not a firm part of the plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人で歩く速さや引き返す目安を共有してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please agree on your walking pace and when to turn back together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の休憩のところで体力を確かめ、帰りの分がつらそうならそこで戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初の休憩地点で体力を確認し復路が難しければ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my energy at the first rest stop. If the return journey seems too difficult, I will turn back there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your strength at the first rest stop and return if the walk back seems difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 目的地にこだわらず、体調と現地の状況を優先してください。お兄様と無理なく散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please put your health and the conditions on site ahead of reaching the destination. Enjoy a comfortable walk with your older brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前でお待ちでしたね。通る場所について確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were waiting in front of the ticket gates. Is there anything you would like to check about where to pass through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベビーカーで通れる改札を探しています。同行者が先に入りましたが、追いかけてよい道が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーで使える場所を探し先に入った同行者への道が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a gate I can use with a stroller. My companion has already gone through, but I do not know which route I can take to follow them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are looking for a stroller-accessible gate and do not know the route to your companion who went ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通れる幅とホームまでの道を確認しましょう。同行者とは連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the width you can pass through and the route to the platform. Can you contact your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話できます。まず先に行かずに待ってもらい、私が使う経路を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話で待ってもらい自分が通る経路を知らせたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call them. First I would like them to wait instead of going ahead, and I want to tell them the route I will take.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to call, ask your companion to wait, and tell them your route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合流場所をそろえておくとよいですね。どのホームへ行く予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is good to agree on a meeting place. Which platform are you planning to go to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先はこのメモにありますが、ホームの番号は確認していません。同行者も番号を知らないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き先メモはあるが双方ともホーム番号を知らない可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The destination is on this note, but I have not checked the platform number. My companion may not know the number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have a destination note but neither of you may know the platform number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先と便からホームを確かめましょう。階段を使わない経路も案内図で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us confirm the platform from the destination and service. We will also check the map for a route without stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: エレベーターまで行った後に別の階段へ出ないよう、ホームまで続けて案内していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: エレベーター後に階段へ出ないよう全体経路を説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you explain the whole route to the platform so that I do not end up at another staircase after taking the elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the entire route to be explained so you do not encounter stairs after the elevator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 全体の経路を確認してお伝えします。現地で通行の案内が変わっていたら、係員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the full route and explain it. If the access signs have changed on site, please ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ホームと階段を使わない道を確認し、同行者へ合流場所を連絡します。急いで追いかけずに進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ホームと段差のない経路を確認し合流場所を知らせて落ち着いて進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the platform and the route without stairs, then tell my companion where to meet. I will go calmly instead of rushing after them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the platform and step-free route, notify your companion of the meeting place, and proceed calmly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では行き先のメモから拝見します。経路が決まってから改札へどうぞ。お子様との移動が穏やかに進みますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let me first see your destination note. Please go through the gate once the route is settled. I hope your journey with your child goes smoothly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の準備をされているのですね。住所の書き方で迷ったところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are preparing to register your move into the city. Is there anything you are unsure about when writing the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 契約の書類と荷物の宛先メモで建物名が違います。短い名前と長い名前があり、どちらを書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書と自作メモで建物名の長短が違い迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The building name differs between the contract documents and my note for delivery addresses. There is a short name and a long name, and I do not know which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the building names in the contract and your own note differ in length, leaving you unsure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つを見比べましょう。番地と部屋番号にも違いがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the two. Are the street number and room number different too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地と部屋番号は同じです。荷物のメモは私が略して書いたので、契約の書類を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋は同じでメモを自分が略記したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street number and room number are the same. I shortened the name myself on the delivery note, so I brought the contract documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the street and room numbers are the same and you abbreviated the name in your note yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正確な情報を確認できるものから相談しましょう。転入について前の住所で受け取った書類もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us start with material that can confirm the accurate information. Do you also have documents you received at your former address about moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒のまま持っています。開けていないので、中に何が入っているかここで一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前住所で受け取った封筒を未開封で持参し内容を見たいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought them in the envelope. I have not opened it, so I would like to check what is inside here together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you brought the unopened envelope received at your former address and want to check its contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で開けて、担当窓口で使う書類を確かめましょう。今日はご本人の分だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please open it yourself, and let us identify the documents needed at the responsible counter. Is today's application just for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私一人の分です。住所の表記を直してから、必要なものがそろっているか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分一人の分で住所修正後に書類の不足を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is just for me. After correcting the address, I would like to ask whether I have everything required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it is just for you and you want to ask about missing documents after correcting the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所と持参書類を順に確認します。分からないところを空欄にしている用紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the address and the documents you brought in order. Have you left any uncertain parts of the form blank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙の建物名は空けています。どの表記を使うか確認し、封筒の書類も見てから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物名は空欄で表記と封筒の中身を確認してから記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have left the building name blank. I will fill it in after confirming which name to use and checking the documents in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the building name is blank and you will fill it in after confirming the wording and envelope contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では住所を確認する窓口へご案内します。二つの資料を一緒にお持ちください。用紙が整ったら、また担当にお見せくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will guide you to the counter that checks addresses. Please bring both documents. Once the form is ready, show it to the staff again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの予約票について伺います。今日の予定を確かめたいということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me ask about the appointment slips you brought. Do you want to check today's schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日だと思って来ましたが、二枚の予約票を持っています。別の受診と取り違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日と思ったが二枚の票で別の受診を取り違えた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came because I thought the appointment was today, but I have two slips. I may have confused it with a different medical appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought it was today but may have confused two slips for different medical appointments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの機関名が書かれた票を先に確認しましょう。ご自分で日付をカレンダーへ写しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first check the slip bearing this institution's name. Did you copy the dates into your calendar yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つとも携帯へ入力しました。ただ、どちらも受診とだけ書いたので、区別できなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両方を受診とだけ入力し機関名で区別できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered both on my phone. But I wrote only 'medical appointment' for each, so I can no longer tell them apart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you entered both only as medical appointments and cannot distinguish them by institution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 票の機関名と日時を分けて見直しましょう。この票の日時には来られそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us review each slip's institution, date and time separately. Would you be able to come at the date and time on this slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時間は仕事があります。私が入力を間違えたので、変更を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 票の時刻は仕事があり自分の入力ミスを認め変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have work at that time. I entered it incorrectly myself, so I would like to discuss changing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you work at the time on the slip, acknowledge your entry error, and request a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更について担当に確認します。候補を聞く前に、来られない時間帯を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the staff about a change. Before asking about alternatives, could you tell me when you cannot come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平日の午前中は難しいです。ただ、受診の時期を変えてよいかは、診療担当の方に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平日午前は難しいが受診時期の変更は診療担当へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Weekday mornings are difficult. However, I would like the medical staff to confirm whether the timing of the consultation can be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that weekday mornings are difficult but you want medical staff to confirm whether the consultation timing can change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療担当へ状況を伝えます。予定が確定するまでは、二枚の票を別々に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the situation to the medical staff. Until the schedule is confirmed, please keep the two slips separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この機関の日時を確認し、変更は担当に相談します。携帯にも機関名を入れて、別の予定と分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: この機関の日時を確認し担当へ相談して携帯に機関名を追加すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check this institution's date and time and discuss any change with the staff. I will also add the institution's name on my phone to distinguish it from the other appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm this institution's date and time, consult the staff, and add its name on your phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では票の内容を照合して担当につなぎます。確認が済むまでこちらでお待ちください。新しい案内が出たら、また一緒に見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will compare the slip information and connect you with the staff. Please wait here until the check is finished. When new instructions are available, let us review them together again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の写真をお持ちですね。見当たらなくなる前の状況も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a photograph of your bicycle. Could you also tell me what happened before it went missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買い物の後に自転車が見つかりませんでした。写真はありますが、写っている場所は今日停めた場所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買物後に見つからず写真の場所は今日の駐輪場所とは違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not find my bicycle after shopping. I have a photo, but the place shown in it is not where I parked today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not find it after shopping and the photo shows a different place from today's parking spot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車体の特徴と、最後の場所を別々に確認しましょう。写真はいつ撮ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the bicycle's features and its last location separately. When was the photo taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一か月前に家の前で撮りました。車体の色は今も同じですが、前かごは交換しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一月前の自宅前の写真で前かごを交換したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took it in front of my home a month ago. The bicycle's color is still the same, but I have replaced the front basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the photo was taken outside your home a month ago and you have replaced the front basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在と違う部分も記録します。交換したかごはどのようなものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record the parts that are different now too. What is the replacement basket like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は黒い大きなかごです。写真では小さい白いかごなので、古い特徴として見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の黒い大かごと写真の白い小かごを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It now has a large black basket. The photo shows a small white one, so please treat that as an old feature.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the current large black basket from the small white basket in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日停めた場所は、どんな目印で覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: What landmarks do you remember near the place where you parked today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の入口ではなく、建物の横の壁に沿った列です。柱に案内板がある場所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口でなく建物横の壁沿いで柱に案内板がある列と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was not by the shop entrance, but in a row along the wall beside the building. There was an information board on a pillar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it was a row along the building's side wall, not the entrance, with an information board on a pillar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場所と写真を分けて伺いました。停めた時間と、ないと気づいた時間も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have noted that location separately from the photo. Do you also know when you parked and when you noticed it was missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後一時に停め、二時ごろ戻りました。写真の場所とは別だと分かるように、今日の経緯をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一時に停め二時に戻り写真とは別の経緯だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I parked at one in the afternoon and returned around two. I will explain today's sequence of events so it is clear that the location is different from the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you parked at one and returned at two, and that today's events concern a different place from the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分けて説明していただき助かりました。現在の特徴と今日の経緯を確認します。思い出したことがあればお知らせください。確認後は、どうぞ気をつけてお帰りになってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining them separately. I will check the current features and today's sequence of events. Please let us know if you remember anything else. Take care on your way home after the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の中にも別の封筒が入っていますね。提出先の指示を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is another envelope inside this one. Shall we check the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返信用の封筒を入れると書いてありました。こちらから送る方法と、返してもらう方法を混同しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信封筒の同封指定を見て送る方法と返送方法を混同したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to include a return envelope. I am mixing up the method for sending it out and the method for getting it sent back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the instruction to enclose a return envelope made you confuse outward and return delivery methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 往路と返信を分けて考えましょう。追跡についての指定は、どちらに書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us consider outward and return delivery separately. For which direction is tracking specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申請書を送る方法の欄にあります。返信の欄には、宛名を書いた封筒とだけあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申請の発送欄に追跡があり返信欄は宛名付き封筒だけと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is in the section about sending the application documents. The return section just says an addressed envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that tracking is specified for sending the application, while the return section only mentions an addressed envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの指定が分かりましたね。返信の費用についても、提出先の案内に記載がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Now we can distinguish the two instructions. Does the recipient's guidance also mention the return postage cost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこは読めていません。自分の住所を書くだけでよいと思ったので、封筒はまだ準備の途中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 費用欄を読まず住所だけでよいと思い準備途中だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not read that part. I thought writing my own address would be enough, so I am still preparing the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not read the cost section, thought the address alone was enough, and are still preparing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返信に必要な準備を提出先へ確認するとよいですね。往路の記録で保存したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to ask the recipient what preparation is needed for the return delivery. Is there anything you want to retain as a record of sending it out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送った書類の行方を確認したいです。どんな記録が残るかを、方法を選ぶ前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送付書類の行方を確認したく方法選択前に記録内容を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to be able to check where the documents I send have gone. Before I choose a method, please tell me what records it leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what records remain before selecting a method, because you want to track the documents you send. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 方法ごとの案内で、確認できる内容と条件を比べましょう。返信の準備が整ってから封をする予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare what can be checked and the conditions in the guidance for each method. Do you plan to seal it once the return preparations are complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信の宛名と費用を確認してから封をします。往路は追跡の指定に合うかと、残る記録を確かめて選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信の宛名と費用を確認し往路の追跡条件と記録を比較すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will seal it after checking the return address and cost. For sending it out, I will choose after checking that the method meets the tracking requirement and what records remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the return address and cost, and compare outward tracking requirements and records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では提出先の案内をもう一度分けて見ましょう。準備がそろいましたら発送を相談できます。また封筒と案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us look at the recipient's instructions again, separating the two directions. Once everything is ready, we can discuss sending it. Please bring the envelope and instructions again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座について相談したいとのことですね。どのような用途を考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss an account. What do you intend to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から生活費を受け取るためです。学生なので、給料を受け取る予定は今のところありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学生で家族から生活費を受け取る目的と給与予定がないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for receiving living expenses from my family. I am a student, so I have no plans to receive a salary at the moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are a student and want to receive living expenses from family, with no current salary plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 生活費の受取りですね。必要な情報を案内で確認します。今日はどんな書類を持ってきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For receiving living expenses, then. I will check the required information in the guidance. What documents have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学生証を持っています。それだけで十分とは思っていないので、ほかに必要なものを聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学生証のみを持参し十分と決めず追加必要書類を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my student ID. I do not assume that alone is enough; I came to ask what else is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you brought only your student ID and want to ask about additional documents without assuming it is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の状況に合わせて確認しましょう。現在お住まいの住所は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check according to your own circumstances. Can you explain your current residential address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 学生寮に住んでいます。寮名と部屋番号を伝えられますが、どんな書類で確認するか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寮名と部屋番号は説明できるが確認用書類が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I live in a student dormitory. I can give the dormitory name and room number, but I do not know which documents are used to verify them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can give the dormitory name and room number but do not know the documents needed for verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所の確認について現在の案内をご説明します。家族からの振込みについても質問がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain the current guidance on address verification. Do you also have questions about transfers from your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座ができた後、家族にどの情報を知らせるか知りたいです。まだ開設できると決まったわけではないので、準備として聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定はしていないが家族へ知らせる受取り情報を準備として聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to know what information I should give my family after the account is opened. It has not yet been decided whether I can open one, so I am asking to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the receiving information to tell your family as preparation, although opening the account is not yet confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず開設に必要な条件を確認し、その後の受取り情報も順に説明できます。質問を書き留めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can first check the conditions for opening an account, then explain the receiving information in order. Would you like to note your questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要書類と寮の住所確認を先にメモします。開設後の情報は、条件が分かってから家族に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要書類と寮住所を先に記録し条件理解後に家族へ情報を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first note the required documents and verification of my dormitory address. I will explain the information after opening to my family once I understand the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will first record the documents and dormitory address verification, then explain the information to family after understanding the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では学生証を拝見し、確認が必要な点を整理しましょう。準備する内容を持ち帰ってご検討ください。またのご相談をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let me see your student ID and organize what needs checking. Please take the preparation details home and consider them. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物の表示についてですか。どの金額を見ていらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the drink display? Which price were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二本でという文字の横に金額があります。一本の金額だと思って見ていたので、何個分か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本でという表示を一本価格と思っていたため何個分か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a price beside the words 'for two bottles.' I had thought it was the price for one, so I want to check how many it covers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how many bottles the price covers because you mistook the two-bottle display for a single-bottle price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の対象と本数を一緒に読みましょう。お持ちの二本は同じ種類ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read which products and quantities the display covers. Are the two bottles you have the same variety?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一方は無糖で、もう一方は甘い味です。容器が同じ形なので、二本として組み合わせられると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無糖と甘い味を容器が同じため組み合わせられると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is unsweetened and the other is sweet. Since the containers have the same shape, I thought they could be combined as two bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the unsweetened and sweet varieties could be combined because their containers look alike. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ容器でも対象が違う可能性があります。表示の商品名と味の指定を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even with the same container, the eligible products may differ. I will check the product names and flavors specified on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この小さい文字が対象の味でしょうか。二本とも含まれるか、商品名で照合していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小文字の味指定を示し二本とも含まれるか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does this small print specify the eligible flavor? Could you compare the product names and check whether both bottles qualify?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point to the small-print flavor specification and ask whether both bottles are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方の商品名を見て確かめましょう。組合せが対象外だった場合は、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the names of both products. What would you like to do if the combination is not eligible?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 対象外なら無糖の一本だけにします。必要な量は一本なので、値引きのために増やすつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無糖一本だけが必要で値引きのために増やさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it is not eligible, I will take just the unsweetened bottle. One bottle is all I need, so I do not intend to buy more for the discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you only need one unsweetened bottle and will not increase the quantity for a discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望の本数を優先して選べますね。一本の場合の金額も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can prioritize the number you want. Let us also check the price for one bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一本の価格を聞いてから決めます。二本の表示だけで安いと判断せず、必要な無糖の商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一本の価格を聞き二本表示だけで安いと決めず必要な品を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide after asking the single-bottle price. I will not assume it is cheap from the two-bottle display alone, and will choose the unsweetened drink I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the single-bottle price and choose what you need without judging it cheap from the two-bottle display alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では無糖の商品と一本の値札を確認します。分かりにくい表示はまたご相談ください。お買い物を続けてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the unsweetened product and its single-bottle price tag. Please ask again about any unclear display. Enjoy the rest of your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩前の道の様子を確認したいのですね。気になった場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the paths before walking. Is there a particular spot you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜の雨で土の道がぬれています。今日は歩きやすい靴ではないので、長く歩くのはやめようかと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土道がぬれ歩きやすい靴でないため長い散歩を控えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The dirt path is wet from last night's rain. I am not wearing shoes suitable for walking today, so I am thinking of avoiding a long walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the dirt path is wet and your shoes are unsuitable, so you want to avoid a long walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の通行案内を確認しましょう。舗装のある短い道なら歩きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the current access guidance. Would you like to walk if there is a short paved path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い道なら考えたいです。ただ、途中まで行ってから土の道へ変わるなら、無理に進みたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い舗装路を検討するが土へ変わるなら進みたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would consider a short path. But if it turns into a dirt path partway through, I do not want to force myself to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you would consider a short paved path but do not want to continue if it becomes a dirt path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図の道の表示と、現地の様子を照合しましょう。今日はどの出口へ戻る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare the map's path markings with the actual conditions. Which exit do you plan to return to today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口の駐車場へ戻ります。靴がぬれたまま遠回りせずに戻れるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口駐車場へぬれた靴で遠回りせず戻る道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will return to the car park at the entrance. I also want to know whether I can return without a detour while my shoes are wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about returning to the entrance car park without a detour in wet shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駐車場への戻り道を先に見ておきましょう。歩かず休む場合の場所も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look at the route back to the car park first. Would you also like to check somewhere to rest instead of walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座って景色を見るだけでもよいです。道の状態を確認できなければ、休む場所へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 景色を見るだけでもよく状態不明なら休憩場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would be happy just sitting and looking at the scenery. If we cannot confirm the path conditions, I would like to go somewhere to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that just enjoying the scenery is fine and you would like a rest area if the conditions are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩場所までの道も確認して案内します。案内図だけで歩けると決めず、その場の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check the route to the rest area and guide you. Please look at the signs on site instead of deciding the route is walkable from the map alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短い舗装路と駐車場への道を確認します。状態が分からなければ散歩を控え、近い場所で休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 舗装路と帰路を確認し不明なら散歩を控え近くで休むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the short paved path and the route to the car park. If the conditions are unclear, I will avoid walking and rest nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the paved path and return route, and avoid walking and rest nearby if conditions are unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では今の案内を見ましょう。履物に合う過ごし方を選んでください。雨上がりの公園で、どうぞゆったりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us look at the current guidance. Please choose an activity that suits your footwear. Enjoy a relaxing time in the park after the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路のメモをご覧になっていますね。今いる駅からの行き方を確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at a route note. Would you like to check how to get there from this station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。訪問先からもらったメモですが、最初に訪問先の駅が書かれていて、読む方向に迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 訪問先の駅から書かれた順序の読み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. This is a note from the place I am visiting, but it starts with their station, so I am unsure which direction to read it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the sequence that starts from the station at your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いる場所と目的地を分けて見ましょう。ご自身が最後に着きたい駅を示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish your current location from the destination. Could you point to the station where you ultimately want to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後に行きたいのはこちらです。メモは相手の駅からこちらへ来る順番なので、私は逆向きに行くことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の目的地を指し相手からの経路だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the station I want to reach. The note lists the route from their station to here, so I will be going in the opposite direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to your destination and explain that the note gives the route from the other person's station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのメモをそのまま逆に読んで乗るのではなく、現在の案内で経路を確認しましょう。乗換駅も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than simply reading that note backward and boarding, let us check the route using current information. We will also confirm the transfer station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ番号のホームに戻ればよいとは考えず、今の案内を見たいです。乗換駅を先に書き留めてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元のホーム番号を逆用せず乗換駅を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume I should return to a platform with the same number; I would like to check the current information. May I first write down the transfer station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the transfer station without reusing the original platform number for the reverse journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた駅を順番に書きましょう。最初の列車の行き先も、現在地からの案内で照らします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us write down the confirmed stations in order. We will also compare the first train's destination with the guidance from your current location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現在地、乗換駅、目的地の三つを分けて書きました。元のメモとは別にして、この順番で聞き返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地と乗換駅と目的地を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written my current station, transfer station and destination separately. I want to keep this apart from the original note and repeat this sequence to confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your current station, transfer station and destination separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しいメモを一緒に確認します。乗換駅では次の列車の表示も見て、こちらの番号だけに頼らず進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the new note together. At the transfer station, also check the next train's signs rather than relying only on the numbers given here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地からの順番と最初の行き先を確認します。逆向きの元メモは参考に留め、乗換先でも表示を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の経路を確認し元メモと現地表示を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the order from my current station and the first train's destination. I will use the original note in the reverse direction only as a reference, and check the signs again at the transfer station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the current route and distinguish the original note from the signs on site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 向きの違いを整理できましたね。今の案内で最初の列車を確認しましょう。メモを持って、お気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have sorted out the difference in direction. Let us check the first train using the current information. Take your note with you, and have a safe journey.
